title: Buddhism, Daoism, Wheel/Path & Akashic-Record Center Lenses
purpose: Sharpen Wheel/Spiral/Path, polarity, useful emptiness, memory/archive and practice lenses around the Potato of Life while keeping Buddhist, Daoist and Theosophical meanings distinct from Potatoverse canon.
epistemic_rule: Comparative resemblance is not historical identity, hidden transmission or metaphysical proof. Own-tradition meaning comes first.

dharma_wheel.finding: The Buddhist dharmacakra symbolizes the Buddha's teaching/turning of the Dharma. Eight-spoked wheels are often related to the Noble Eightfold Path.
dharma_wheel.project_use: Useful for a coordinated multi-aspect practice around one teaching center. This clarifies Wheel as structured coordination rather than automatically a Ring or Spiral.
dharma_wheel.boundary: The Dharma wheel is not a Potatoverse wheel and Buddhism does not teach the Potato spiral.

eightfold_path.finding: The Noble Eightfold Path coordinates right view, intention, speech, action, livelihood, effort, mindfulness and concentration; Buddhist traditions commonly group these under wisdom, ethical conduct and mental cultivation/concentration.
eightfold_path.project_use: Strong comparator for a path that is multidimensional rather than a single vertical ascent. Practice can change view, conduct, attention and livelihood at once.
eightfold_path.boundary: The Eightfold Path belongs to Buddhist soteriology and should not be rewritten as Potatoism.

dao_and_wuwei.finding: Daoist traditions center on dao/Way; wu wei is a complex concept of non-forcing/non-doing whose interpretations are richer than simple passivity.
dao_and_wuwei.project_use: Supports distinguishing effective cultivation from coercive force: Garden/Gardener should alter conditions without confusing domination with growth.
dao_and_wuwei.boundary: A potato does not literally practice wu wei; that is a project analogy.

yin_yang.finding: In Daoist/correlative cosmological use, yin and yang function as complementary differentiated tendencies whose conjunction and cyclic alternation help describe change.
yin_yang.project_use: Useful correction to moralized up/down and light/shadow readings: polarity can be functional and alternating rather than good-versus-evil.
yin_yang.boundary: Yin/yang are not identical to Heaven/Below, Father/Son, light/dark or material/spiritual.

useful_void.finding: Daodejing chapter 11 famously uses wheel hub, vessel hollow and doors/windows to show how usefulness can depend on open/empty capacity as well as solid form.
useful_void.project_use: Strong comparator for Door, House and center-as-capacity: a useful center need not be the most filled place.
useful_void.boundary: The project uses a structural analogy; Daoist wu/nonbeing is not reduced to an engineering aperture.

akashic_records.historical_context: The modern 'Akashic Records' concept developed in late nineteenth-century Theosophical/esoteric currents from reinterpretations of Sanskrit ākāśa. Scholarly discussion notes that Blavatsky herself did not use the later fixed term 'Akashic Record', while later Theosophists developed the cosmic-record idea.
akashic_records.project_use: Use Akashic Tree only as a reader metaphor for connected provenance/history/memory across the archive: roots=source/history, trunk=present synthesis, branches=Rooms, leaves=questions, fruit=Works.
akashic_records.boundary: The project does not treat a supernatural all-events record as established fact and should not backdate the Theosophical concept into Buddhism or Indian traditions generally.

synthesis.wheel_vs_spiral: Wheel coordinates recurrence/teaching/practice; Ring is project recurrence with zero net displacement; Spiral is project recurrence with non-zero displacement. They can be compared but not collapsed.
synthesis.path_vs_axis: Path describes practice/sequence; Axis describes orientation. A path can cross an Axis without becoming the Axis.
synthesis.polarity_vs_morality: Up/down, yin/yang, light/shadow and material/spiritual are different distinctions. None should inherit moral value automatically.
synthesis.archive_vs_akashic: Archive is documented records/provenance. Akashic Tree is optional metaphor. Literal Akashic Records remain an esoteric belief claim.
synthesis.culture_vs_cult: Culture/subculture describe social formation; high-control analysis requires observable mechanisms such as isolation, authority concentration, punishment, dependency and exit cost.
